bio: The restaurant on the first floor of Berlin's Grand Hyatt is modern and spacious with an open layout. For the perfect start (and end) to your evening, head to the magnificent cocktail bar, which boasts a truly impressive array of whiskies from across the globe. The culinary offering comprises two distinct styles: modern cuisine (served à la carte or as a five-course set menu) and a good sushi selection – sushi enthusiasts can opt to sit at the dedicated sushi counter....
